from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfitData(BaseModel):
    """Extracted profit information from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company, e.g., '沪电股份', '全聚德'")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The total profit (利润总额) amount as reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, e.g., '元', 'CNY'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度', '1-3月'")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="Where the profit is located, e.g., '合并利润表'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt containing the profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profit_data: list[CompanyProfitData]
